about: Each taboo is an act that the people who care will react to, not one that cannot happen. Reactions run from least to most severe and depend on who learns of it, how sure they are, how much they care and what they can do. Source: bible section 3.2 and design section 7; the lists are ranges for judging plausibility, not a menu to choose from.

killing_a_cop.name: Killing a cop
who_cares: the precinct and the whole police department
every family whose business a manhunt would disrupt
typical_reactions: raids and pressure on every social club and bar the dead officer's colleagues know
the families disown or hand over the killer to end the heat
a manhunt that does not stop for months
federal cases built around the killing and the crew behind it
scales_with: how much heat the families already carry
can_be_permitted_by: a boss with the consent of the other families, which is rare and still costs the family dearly

killing_a_reporter.name: Killing a reporter
who_cares: the families, who fear what a martyred reporter does to public tolerance
typical_reactions: national attention and a crackdown
pressure from other bosses on whoever allowed it
the killer given up or disowned
a story told by the paper after the death that sinks the people involved
scales_with: how well known the reporter was
can_be_permitted_by: a boss, knowing the usual substitutes (a smashed camera, a lost Sunday edition) exist because a killing is so expensive

killing_or_striking_a_made_man_without_s.name: Killing or striking a made man without sanction
who_cares: the man's capo, crew and sponsor
typical_reactions: a demand for explanation
a sit-down
a retaliatory killing
a war between crews or families
quiet acceptance, or even relief, if a boss wanted it
scales_with: how the boss feels about the victim
can_be_permitted_by: the commission, for a killing across families

holding_out.name: Holding out
who_cares: the capo or boss being shorted
partners and crew who also did not get a share
typical_reactions: a beating and a debt (a tune-up)
a demotion or the loss of a racket
exile or a ruined name
death, for a large or repeated theft
scales_with: how much the man is worth to the crew
whether he confesses before he is found out
can_be_permitted_by: the capo or boss, who may forgive or let a man repay

informing.name: Informing
who_cares: law enforcement, who protect the informant
typical_reactions: suspicion that ends a man's standing
isolation, then a killing on bad information
a hunt for a confirmed informant and sometimes his relatives
protection in the Witness Security program at a price
can_be_permitted_by: a boss who orders a man to feed the Feds chosen information on purpose

narcotics_against_the_family_ban.name: Dealing narcotics where the family forbids it
who_cares: a boss and capos who forbid it for honor, heat or belief
the young zealots who believe in the ban
police and the Feds, if the trade draws attention
typical_reactions: ignored
taxed through a front man
demoted, fined or cut off
killed, depending on whom he deals for and who is looking
can_be_permitted_by: a boss, who may officially forbid it and still take a cut

a_made_mans_wife.name: A made man's wife
typical_reactions: a beating
forced exile or a sit-down
an unsanctioned killing
a feud carried into another family's house if the marriage was between families
scales_with: whether it was an insult or an affair
how the husband's crew regards him
can_be_permitted_by: the husband, by forgiving or hushing it
his boss, who may decide it is not worth a war

violence_in_the_oakridge_sanctuary.name: Violence in the Oakridge sanctuary
who_cares: judges and politicians who live there
typical_reactions: retaliation from every family
a surge of police and press attention
hostile witnesses from wealthy, well-connected people
the sanctuary understanding broken for everyone
scales_with: the state of the peace between the families
can_be_permitted_by: all four bosses together, or the commission, for a particular case

disrespecting_a_boss_in_public.name: Disrespecting a boss in public
typical_reactions: an apology and a payment
a beating
a public humiliation in return
a sanctioned killing
can_be_permitted_by: the boss himself, who may swallow it and so decide something about himself

drift: A boss can quietly permit what his family officially forbids, and a taboo fades when the people who enforced it are dead or discredited. Two crews can disagree about whether an act was a violation at all. Consequences flow through the knowledge and rumour systems: who learns what, and when.
